ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixel coverage localized in scarring patterns.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe and center-right lobe, representing surface scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both fluke lobes; extensive circular scarring (likely from previous barnacle attachments) across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, overlapping cluster of white circular scars on the upper right lobe creating a unique high-contrast texture.
